descriptions: This dataset contains all Arab West Report special reports from the year 2014. This dataset is notable because much of it is the work of interns at the Center For Arab West Understanding during the 2014 summer internship season. The subject matter of the articles can broadly be described as observations on religious holidays in Egypt, specifically, Holy Week and Ramadan, and the intercultural, interfaith experiences of interns living in Cairo.

All reports are written in English, though some reports feature Arabic text or cite Arabic sources. Team including job titles: Sparks, MA M.R.
